source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Members (May 2022)
source.content:
The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for up to 5 new members. Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

**What does the WRC do?**

* Update and improve the[ WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). (See our public [GitHub repository](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations) and the [WCA Forum page](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/regulations/5).)
* Read competition reports and respond to incidents. 
* Engage with the WCA community for feedback about the Regulations. 
* Address any issues and inquiries related to the Regulations.

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2021.9](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents).

<!-- break -->

**The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:**

* Regularly check and respond to email (5-10 emails/day). 
* Objectively apply the letter and spirit of the WCA Regulations. 
* Compassionately and constructively discuss how to address incidents. 
* Time commitment of 5-10 hours per week. 

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WRC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

* Writing fluent, clear English while communicating across language differences. 
* Cubing community discussions, online or offline.
* The history of the WCA Regulations.
* Using GitHub and/or writing code (especially Python, Java, Ruby on Rails).
* Project management, leadership, addressing organisational incentives, advocacy, and/or legal work.

The priority application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now **until June 3th, 2022, 23:59 UTC privately to Iván Brigidano** (iperez@worldcubeassociation.org). Candidacy documents must be in **PDF format**, and must include:

* A brief personal introduction. 
* A summary of experiences/accomplishments to demonstrate that you can meet the requirements.
* What motivates you to join the WRC? 
* Do you have any topics/issues that you are passionate about helping the WRC improve? 
* Optionally, any additional experience that is relevant to WRC work.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Iván Brigidano (iperez@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WRC and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会招募成员（2022 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）计划招募最多 5 名新成员，欢迎不同背景的社区成员申请。申请面向所有人开放，不要求目前在 WCA 任职。

**WRC 负责什么？**

* 更新和完善 [WCA 规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)；可参阅公开的 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations)和 [WCA 论坛版块](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/regulations/5)。
* 阅读比赛报告，处理比赛中的意外事件。
* 与 WCA 社区交流，收集对规则的反馈。
* 处理与规则有关的问题和咨询。

WRC 的正式权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2021.9](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents)。

**申请者应符合以下要求：**

* 经常查收并回复邮件，每天约 5–10 封。
* 客观地按照 WCA 规则的条文及其精神处理问题。
* 讨论事件处理方式时，能够体谅当事人，并提出建设性意见。
* 每周能够投入 5–10 小时。

以下经验并非必需，但会对 WRC 的工作有所帮助：

* 能用流畅、清楚的英语与不同语言背景的人沟通。
* 参与过线上或线下魔方社区讨论。
* 了解 WCA 规则的历史。
* 使用 GitHub 或编写代码，尤其是 Python、Java、Ruby on Rails。
* 项目管理、领导工作、处理组织激励问题、倡议工作或法律工作。

优先申请期为**即日起至 2022 年 6 月 3 日 23:59 UTC**，请私下将申请材料发送给 **Iván Brigidano**（iperez@worldcubeassociation.org）。材料须为 **PDF 格式**，并包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 能够证明自己符合要求的经历或成果。
* 你为什么想加入 WRC？
* 你是否有特别希望帮助 WRC 改进的议题或问题？
* 【可选】其他与 WRC 工作有关的经验。

你会很快收到确认材料是否齐全的回复，也可能受邀与 WRC 负责人面谈。

如有疑问，欢迎联系 Iván Brigidano（iperez@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢你愿意为 WRC 和 WCA 出力！
